salesIncrease.question: Will my sales really increase in the first month?
salesIncrease.answer: Yes! Our average agencies see a 120-150% reservation increase in the first month. Your AI-powered WhatsApp bot serves customers 24/7 — midnight, weekends, holidays, it doesn't matter. You never miss an opportunity.

setup.question: How does the setup work?
setup.answer: Very easy! Create your account, add your tours, and submit an integration request from the WhatsApp Management panel. Our team handles the Meta Cloud API setup for you. You just manage your tours — all the technical infrastructure is on us.

whatsappCost.question: Is there an extra fee for WhatsApp integration?

payment.question: Can I collect payments directly from customers?
payment.answer: Yes! With our payment integration, you can send instant payment links via WhatsApp and collect payments within minutes. Payment tracking is handled automatically.

tourLimit.question: How many tours can I add?
tourLimit.answer: Up to 10 tours on the Starter plan, unlimited tours on Professional and Enterprise plans. The difference is in message limits and language count. You can upgrade your plan anytime based on your needs.

cancellation.question: What happens if I cancel?
cancellation.answer: You can cancel anytime, no contract. When you cancel, you'll continue to receive service until the end of the current period. We don't even ask for a credit card during the 14-day free trial.
